dreams.dream: I was standing on a bridge at night while a train passed below. I felt nervous but also curious because there was a bright door at the end of the bridge.

Symbols like train, door, bridge may point toward direction, timing, momentum, or feeling carried by life. Consider what part of waking life feels similar, then write one practical support step you can take today.
